title: Listing
description: A source that names papers: a GitHub paper list, or a saved arXiv search. A paper is listed in it, under a heading.

kind.description: list (a GitHub paper list) or query (a saved arXiv search)

url.description: where it is: the repository's page, or the arXiv API query

topic.description: what it is about, in the words of the survey that chose it

licence.description: the repository's licence as GitHub's API reports it, or none reported

last_changed.description: the last push to the repository, or the newest paper a query found (YYYY-MM-DD)

entries.description: papers resolved: distinct arXiv identifiers in its links

unresolved.description: links that named a paper without an arXiv identifier (a count only)

machine_built.description: the survey found signs that scripts or a model build part of the list
